text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means writing tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Thanks to regular testing, developers gain confidence that their software is reliable and that new changes will not break existing features. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to better quality.
